purpose: Compare repeated GPU steps with a single-process CPU loop that repeats eval_step after initialization.
preconditions: reports/tlul_fifo_sync_repeated_steps_scaling.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: single-process CPU repeated eval_step wall time for nstates=512
GPU repeated kernel-launch throughput for nstates=512
CPU/GPU state-step throughput ratio for this seed and gate shape
non_claims: not a full RTL application throughput claim
no target-breadth claim because only tlul_fifo_sync is exercised
CPU repeated steps are modeled as repeated eval_step calls after initialization
comparison_policy.next_precision_step: add a second seed if repeated-step results still show a GPU win
